from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information about one document's case cause/type."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title/name of the court document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause/type (案由) identified in the document")
    is_matches_target: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case cause matches '行政主体-行政检查（监察）'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_case_infos: list[DocumentCaseInfo]
